items.text: I wanted to like the game so much but its just so jank. I like a little bit of jank but I mean who on earth designed the conversation and combat system like are you on crack? Every time I start a playthrough something stupid happens. came back to kleg and someone set it on fire. go out salvaging well all of a sudden my eva suit that had full battery and oxygen and condition just stops working. building system is jank as hell.
items.text_zh: 我本来非常想喜欢这款游戏，但它就是太粗糙了。我能接受一点点粗糙，但我是说，到底是谁设计出这种对话和战斗系统的，你是嗑药了吗？每次我开一局游戏，都会发生一些蠢事。回到克莱格，有人把它点着了。出去打捞，好吧，突然之间我那充满电、氧气和完好状态的EVA服就停止工作了。建造系统也是粗糙得要命。

observations.description: EVA服在电池、氧气和状态全满时突然停止工作。
observations.evidence: my eva suit that had full battery and oxygen and condition just stops working
observations.evidence_zh: 我那套电量、氧气和状态都满的EVA服突然就不工作了

items.text:
This can be fun but you'll need a browser open to figure things out. There are also a variety of bugs.

To be fair cobbling together a ship and flying around are fun!

I had fun derping around in the early game but my first reload was the tutorial ship smashing into the planet's surface. I also have had several reloads from the space suit helmet seemingly not sealing and leading to dying with full battery, O2, and filters.
 
Things that I needed to look up:
Proper O2 pressure (over 20)
How to hook up sensors and panels (I had gotten it but there really isn't any major UI indication)
How to bulk order tasks (maybe just daft there but there are several steps)

Also lots of time just staring at the game trying to find what I missed

I don’t think I’m going to make it to late game simply because (apart from flying around) other games, like ONI, have more interesting ways of presenting the same struggles for me personally.
items.text_zh:
这可以很好玩，但你需要开着浏览器才能搞清楚事情。而且还有各种各样的bug。

平心而论，拼凑一艘飞船并四处飞行是很好玩的！

我在游戏早期到处瞎搞玩得很开心，但我的第一次重新读档是教学飞船撞上了行星表面。我还因为宇航服头盔似乎没有密封，导致在电池、氧气和过滤器全满的情况下死亡而重新读档了好几次。

我不得不去查的东西：
正确的氧气压力（超过20）
如何连接传感器和面板（我搞定了，但真的没有任何主要的UI提示）
如何批量订购任务（也许只是我笨，但有好几个步骤）

还有大量时间只是盯着游戏，试图找出我漏掉了什么

我觉得我大概到不了游戏后期，仅仅是因为（除了四处飞行之外）其他游戏，比如《缺氧》，对我个人来说有更有趣的方式来呈现同样的挣扎。
